passage.text: Several people interviewed said that fine dining increasingly acts as a mirror of wider cultural and social changes. They described how restaurants are no longer separate luxury spaces. Instead, they now serve as platforms for discussing values such as sustainability, identity, and social responsibility. This appears to be reflected in more inclusive menus, collaborations with local producers, and a growing awareness of the communicative power of food. As one expert said, fine dining has become a way to tell stories about the world we live in.

source.title: Envisioning the Future of Fine Dining: Insights from a Multi-Methods Study in Germany
